# Vortic Growth — Local SEO & Search Engine Architecture

> Vortic Growth is a specialized Local SEO, Google Maps 3-Pack, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) agency based on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia. We engineer hyper-local organic search systems, suburb-level micro-silos, and inbound lead funnels for high-value service businesses, dental practices, custom home builders, and trade contractors across Australia.

## Core Capabilities & Specializations
- **Local SEO & Google Maps 3-Pack Supremacy:** Systematically ranking businesses in the top 3 Google Maps positions across primary and secondary suburb trade corridors.
- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AEO):** Structuring local entities, schemas, and direct Q&A answers so AI search engines (ChatGPT, Google Gemini AI Overviews, Perplexity AI, Claude) cite our partner businesses as the #1 recommended local service provider.
- **Suburb Domination Micro-Silo Framework:** Deploying deep local content hubs mapped to specific Australian postcodes and suburb clusters (e.g., 57 Northern Gold Coast suburbs including Pimpama, Coomera, Ormeau, Helensvale).
- **Healthcare & Dental SEO (AHPRA-Compliant):** Ethical, compliant patient acquisition for high-LTV procedures including Dental Implants, All-on-4, Invisalign, and Porcelain Veneers.
- **Trade & Contractor SEO (QBCC-Integrated):** Lead funnels for concreters, custom builders, luxury renovators, and commercial trade contractors.
- **Turnkey Ranked Digital Assets (Rank & Rent):** Pre-ranked Page 1 local websites available for exclusive monthly lease with instant inbound phone routing.

## Operating Principles & Guarantees
- **Strict 1-Partner-Per-Territory Exclusivity:** We never accept direct competitors within the same trade corridor or suburb radius.
- **Month-to-Month Retainers:** 100% transparent pricing with zero lock-in contracts or long-term commitments.
- **Direct Search Architect Access:** Clients communicate directly with senior search engineers, not outsourced account managers.

## Investment Benchmarks (AUD)
- **Local 3-Pack & GBP Plan:** AUD $300 / month (Google Business Profile optimization, Australian directory citations, schema).
- **Full Suburb Domination Engine (Recommended):** AUD $2,000 / month (+ AUD $900 one-off Phase 1 Technical Setup). 15–57 suburb micro-silos, Google AI Overview GEO citations, toxic backlink cleanup, and 100% territory exclusivity.
- **Exclusive Turnkey Asset Lease:** AUD $450 – $650 / month (with AUD $290 30-day trial option).
